floater.name: aya_cinematic
floater.title: AYAstorm Cinematic Controls
floater.text: Active only when View Mode (Graphics tab) is "Cinematic". Mode change requires restart; sliders apply live. "D" restores Cinematic preset / LL default.

panel.label: General
panel.name: tab_general

check_box.name: cb_Deferred
check_box.label: Deferred Rendering (required for shadows/SSAO/SSR/DoF)
check_box.tool_tip: Master switch. Disabling kills almost every Cinematic feature.

check_box.name: cb_DeferredSSAO
check_box.label: Screen Space Ambient Occlusion (SSAO)
check_box.tool_tip: Approximate contact shadows / ambient darkening.

check_box.name: cb_Glow
check_box.label: Glow / Bloom
check_box.tool_tip: HDR bloom pass on bright pixels.

check_box.name: cb_AttachedParticles
check_box.label: Render Attached Particles
check_box.tool_tip: Particles emitted from attachments on avatars.

panel.text: Tip: change View Mode in Preferences → Graphics. Restart the viewer after switching to apply.

check_box.name: cb_ShadowAutoDistance
check_box.label: Automatic shadow distance
check_box.tool_tip: When on, viewer chooses cascade distances; manual sliders below are ignored.

check_box.name: cb_DeferredSSAO_ssao_tab
check_box.label: SSAO master (same toggle as General tab)

check_box.name: cb_DeferredBlurLight
check_box.label: Blur deferred lights
check_box.tool_tip: Soften the per-light contributions in the deferred pass.

check_box.name: cb_DepthOfField
check_box.label: Enable Depth of Field
check_box.tool_tip: Cinematic preset default ON; LL default OFF.

check_box.name: cb_DoFHighQuality
check_box.label: High-quality DoF (4× CoF, depth-gated)
check_box.tool_tip: Higher GPU cost; Cinematic preset default ON.

check_box.name: cb_DoFFront
check_box.label: Front-of-focus blur
check_box.tool_tip: Allow objects in front of the focus plane to blur, not just behind.

check_box.name: cb_DoFChroma
check_box.label: Couple chromatic aberration to DoF
check_box.tool_tip: On: R/G/B offset scales with DoF blur. Off: radial vignette at screen edges only.

check_box.name: cb_DoFAlphas
check_box.label: Include alpha-blended surfaces in DoF depth
check_box.tool_tip: On: alpha surfaces (cutoff 0.7) contribute to DoF. Off: excluded (cutoff 1.0).

check_box.name: cb_SSR
check_box.label: Enable Screen Space Reflections
check_box.tool_tip: Cinematic preset default ON; LL default OFF.

check_box.name: cb_MotionBlur
check_box.label: Enable Motion Blur
check_box.tool_tip: Cinematic preset default ON; LL default OFF.

check_box.name: cb_MBSelf
check_box.label: Blur self avatar
check_box.tool_tip: Include self avatar in velocity buffer.

check_box.name: cb_MBOthers
check_box.label: Blur other avatars
check_box.tool_tip: Include other avatars in velocity buffer. Disable to keep them crisp in portrait/group shots.

check_box.name: cb_SMAAT2x
check_box.label: SMAA T2x temporal resolve (may ghost on motion)
check_box.tool_tip: Requires AA type ≥ 2. Edge stabilization at cost of motion ghosting.

check_box.name: cb_VolEnable
check_box.label: Enable volumetric lighting (godrays)
check_box.tool_tip: Master switch for the AYA godrays composite.

check_box.name: cb_VolDir
check_box.label: Directional fade (sun-below-horizon)
check_box.tool_tip: Adds GODRAYS_FADE permutation. Toggling rebuilds shaders live (1-2s).

check_box.name: cb_EnableFullbright
check_box.label: Enable fullbright textures (global)
check_box.tool_tip: If off, fullbright textures render as regular shaded surfaces (applies to all modes).

check_box.name: cb_DeferredLights
check_box.label: Render in-world point/spot lights
check_box.tool_tip: If off, non-attached point/spot lights are suppressed.

check_box.name: cb_OwnAttachedLights
check_box.label: Render own attached lights
check_box.tool_tip: If off, lights attached to your own avatar are suppressed.

check_box.name: cb_OtherAttachedLights
check_box.label: Render others' attached lights
check_box.tool_tip: If off, lights attached to other avatars are suppressed.

panel.label: AYAstorm View FX
panel.name: tab_aya_view_fx
panel.text: AYAstorm View (r14-r20) 由来の追加効果を Cinematic mode に opt-in 配線。default OFF。live cvar (再起動不要)。AYA さんが画面を見て 1 件ずつ A/B 判断するための窓口。

check_box.name: cb_R14VolAtm
check_box.label: r14 Volumetric Atmosphere + Sun Dazzle
check_box.tool_tip: 高度に応じた空気密度勾配 + scene-referred linear 積分 (空の物理的混色)。空全体の色相/明度が変わる。

check_box.name: cb_R16Aerial
check_box.label: r16 Aerial Perspective (Rayleigh λ⁻⁴)
check_box.tool_tip: 遠景の青ヘイズ重み付け。遠距離オブジェクトに青みがかかる。

check_box.name: cb_R18Cloud
check_box.label: r18 Cloud Volumetric (slab raymarch)
check_box.tool_tip: 雲を平面ではなく厚みのある体積として raymarch。立体感が出るが GPU 負荷あり。

check_box.name: cb_R15Godrays
check_box.label: r15 Godrays (AYA 経路)
check_box.tool_tip: AYA 独自の godrays 積分パス。BD の RenderVolumetricLighting と独立。同時 ON 時は重複加算注意。

check_box.name: cb_R19Trans
check_box.label: r19 Translucency (wrap-around + back-light)
check_box.tool_tip: 肌/葉の半透過っぽい光抜けを近似。tier は AYAR19TranslucencyIntensity 共有 (default 1)。

check_box.name: cb_R20SSS
check_box.label: r20 Avatar Skin SSS (screen-space 5-tap separable blur)
check_box.tool_tip: 肌領域に screen-space SSS ブラー。BoM body 等にも適用。tuning cvar (Radius/Strength/GlowGain) は AYAstorm View と共通。

panel.text: Notes: · これらは View Mode = Cinematic (AYAVisualRealismEnabled=2) のときだけ効果あり。 · live cvar なので checkbox 切替で即反映 (再起動不要)。 · 受入完了後、cvar が default の OFF のままで良ければそのまま残してください。気に入った組み合わせは AYA さんと別 phase で default 化議論。
